{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Edge where
  | mk (u v : Nat)

inductive Result where
  | ok (order blocked : List Nat)
  | err (msg : String)

def valid_n (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  n ≤ 10

def valid_edges (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ edges, e.1 < n ∧ e.2 < n

def valid_input (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Prop :=
  valid_n n ∧ valid_edges n edges

def dedup_edges (edges : List Edge) : List Edge :=
  edges.filter (fun e => edges.indexOf e == e) -- placeholder; actual dedup below

def dedup_edges' (edges : List Edge) : List Edge :=
  let rec go (acc : List Edge) (rest : List Edge) : List Edge :=
    match rest with
    | [] => acc
    | e :: es =>
      if acc.contains e then go acc es
      else go (acc ++ [e]) es
  go [] edges

def indegree (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (v : Nat) : Nat :=
  edges.filter (fun e => e.2 = v).length

def out_edges (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (edges.filter (fun e => e.1 = u)).map (fun e => e.2)

def kahn_order (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : List Nat :=
  let edges' := dedup_edges' edges
  let rec go (remaining : List Nat) (indeg : List Nat) : List Nat :=
    match remaining with
    | [] => []
    | _ =>
      let zero_indeg := remaining.filter (fun v => indeg.get! v = 0)
      match zero_indeg with
      | [] => []
      | _ =>
        let min_v := zero_indeg.min! (fun a b => a < b)
        let rest := remaining.erase min_v
        let new_indeg := indeg.map (fun v =>
          if out_edges n edges' min_v.contains v then indeg.get! v - 1 else indeg.get! v)
        min_v :: go rest new_indeg
  let all_vertices := List.range n
  let init_indeg := all_vertices.map (fun v => indegree n edges' v)
  go all_vertices init_indeg

def blocked_vertices (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (order : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let all_vertices := List.range n
  let order_set := order.toSet
  let blocked := all_vertices.filter (fun v => ¬ order_set.contains v)
  blocked

def solve (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Result :=
  if valid_n n then
    if valid_edges n edges then
      let order := kahn_order n edges
      let blocked := blocked_vertices n edges order
      Result.ok order blocked
    else
      Result.err "invalid edges"
  else
    Result.err "invalid n"

theorem thm_O1 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    match solve n edges with
    | Result.ok o b => o = order ∧ b = blocked
    | Result.err _ => False
  := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    (match solve n edges with
     | Result.ok o b => o = order
     | Result.err _ => False) ∧
    order.length ≤ n ∧
    (∀ v ∈ order, v < n) ∧
    (order.Nodup)
  := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    (match solve n edges with
     | Result.ok o b => o = order ∧ b = blocked
     | Result.err _ => False) ∧
    (blocked.Sorted (fun a b => a < b)) ∧
    (order.toSet ∪ blocked.toSet = (List.range n).toSet) ∧
    (order.toSet ∩ blocked.toSet = ∅)
  := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    (match solve n edges with
     | Result.ok o b => o = order ∧ b = blocked
     | Result.err _ => False) ∧
    (let edges' := dedup_edges' edges
     let indeg' := (List.range n).map (fun v => indegree n edges' v)
     ∀ v < n, indeg'.get! v = (edges.filter (fun e => e.2 = v)).length)
  := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h : valid_input n edges) (v : Nat) (hv : v < n) (hloop : (Edge.mk v v) ∈ edges) :
  ∃ (order blocked : List Nat),
    (match solve n edges with
     | Result.ok o b => o = order ∧ b = blocked
     | Result.err _ => False) ∧
    blocked.contains v
  := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (edges : List Edge) :
  match solve 0 edges with
  | Result.ok o b => o = [] ∧ b = []
  | Result.err _ => False
  := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  (∃ (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge), valid_input n edges ∧
    match solve n edges with
    | Result.ok o b => True
    | Result.err _ => False) ∧
  (∃ (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge), valid_input n edges ∧
    match solve n edges with
    | Result.ok o b => True
    | Result.err _ => False)
  := by sorry

end Contract",
